item.title: Man killed after semi-truck, van collide in Rochester
item.description: A man was killed after his van collided with a semi-truck in Rochester on Thursday night. Rochester fatal crash According to the Minnesota State Patrol, around 9:45 p.m., a van driver and a semi-truck driver were northbound on Highway 63. Authorities say near 80th Street Southeast, the two vehicles "made contact." The van driver, identified as 48-year-old Daniel Schandorff, died at the hospital after the crash.
